extracted_text: 1. INTRODUCTION BR-07 File upload accepts only . pdf, . docx, . txt The system shall validate uploaded files to accept only PDF, DOCX, and TXT formats. BR-08 Maximum file size enforced: 10MB The system shall reject files larger than 10 megabytes during upload. 2. FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS 2.1 Document Parsing The system shall use PyMuPDF for PDF text extraction preserving structure. The system shall use python-docx for DOCX extraction. The system shall provide OCR fallback for scanned PDFs returning error message. 2.2 Structure Identification The system shall identify headers, requirement IDs (BR-##), and body text. 3. STORAGE The system shall store extracted_text in PostgreSQL with status 'Ready for Analysis' and calculated word_count. 4. DELETION The system shall permanently delete document and cascade to requirements, validation_results tables. Word count test: this document has approximately 150 words.
